turns.q: How many PMAY-G houses in total, and how many completed?
turns.answer:
PMAY-G — Meghalaya (statewide), across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24):
- PMAY-G houses: 1,71,107 (including 126 registered with a sanctioned amount of ₹0 and no house sanctioned yet)
- Completed houses: 1,29,941
- In progress (House Sanctioned, Plinth or Roof Cast): 41,041
- Not started or no status recorded (Proposed Site, Existing site or no status): 125
turns.sql:
SELECT
  'MEGHALAYA' AS entity_key,
  'Meghalaya' AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay

turns.rewritten: How many PMAY-G beneficiaries are there in GABIL SONGGITCHAM?
turns.sql:
SELECT
  village_code AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_village_name) AS name,
  MAX(lgd_block) AS block,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS district,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  village_code = ANY(
    ARRAY[275189]
  )
GROUP BY
  village_code

  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE

SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,

turns.q: How many PMAY-G houses are there in Ampathi constituency?
turns.answer: PMAY-G houses in Ampathi assembly constituency, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 3,409.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(ac_name) AS entity_key,
  MAX(ac_name) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  UPPER(ac_name) = ANY(
    ARRAY['AMPATHI']
  )
GROUP BY
  UPPER(ac_name)

turns.answer:
PMAY-G is a government scheme implemented through executive guidelines and budgetary allocation, not a law passed by Parliament, meaning there is no individual legal entitlement to a house under it.

- **Launch and Continuation** — Launched on 1 April 2016 by restructuring the Indira Awaas Yojana, with the Union Cabinet approving continuation for FY 2024-25 to FY 2028-29.
- **Legal Status** — Operates as a mission rather than a statutory law, so beneficiary selection depends on eligibility lists (SECC/Awaas+) and Gram Sabha approval rather than a court-enforceable guarantee.
- **Target Beneficiaries** — Aims to provide pucca homes with basic amenities to rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha/severely damaged houses.
- **Financial Assistance** — Provides ₹1.20 lakh per house in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in North-Eastern, Himalayan, hilly, difficult, and IAP districts.
- **Construction Requirements** — Mandates a minimum house size of 25 sqm (including cooking area) and requires a toilet as an integral part of the house.
- **Timeline** — The house is expected to be completed within 12 months of the date of sanction.

For the most current status of your specific application or any time-sensitive figures, please verify directly on the official PMAY-Gramin portal (pmayg.nic.in) or contact your local Block office or Gram Panchayat.

turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  UPPER(lgd_district) = ANY(
    ARRAY['RI BHOI']
  )
GROUP BY
  UPPER(lgd_district)

turns.q: How many PMAY houses in GABIL SONGGITCHAM?
turns.answer: PMAY-G houses in Gabil Songgitcham village (Bajengdoba block, North Garo Hills), across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 345.
turns.rewritten: How many PMAY-G houses are there in GABIL SONGGITCHAM?
turns.sql:
SELECT
  village_code AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_village_name) AS name,
  MAX(lgd_block) AS block,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS district,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  village_code = ANY(
    ARRAY[275189]
  )
GROUP BY
  village_code

GROUP BY financial_year_short
ORDER BY financial_year_short
